description: Stratified annotation queue for FOLLOWED-judge calibration on the XPIA run. The 100 records are allocated across BIPIA (52), LLMail (38), and InjecAgent (10). Within each source, the quota is split evenly between records where an adversarial instruction was followed and records where it was refused. Each record also retains its benign task instructions. The 'require' field is one of: adv_followed (at least one adversarial instruction with followed=1), adv_refused (at least one adversarial instruction and none followed), or any (no outcome constraint).
